smokescreen.title: Sixth: Smokescreen
smokescreen.description: Produce a cloud of purple smoke, obscuring your or an ally's location.

smokescreen_smash.title: Sixth: Smokescreen Smash
smokescreen_smash.description: Use while sneaking to punch forward, knocking back enemies and producing purple smoke ahead of you.

float.title: Seventh: Float
float.description: Allows you to float into the air when held. Helpful when fighting enemies that damage the ground.

blackwhip.title: Fifth: Blackwhip
blackwhip.description: Shoot out a tendril of energy, allowing you to bind an enemy and bring them toward you. Works well with Float.

black_chain.title: Third and Fifth: Black-Chain
black_chain.description: Infuse Blackwhip with stored Fajin energy, allowing you to swing it at enemies.

carnage.title: Carnage
carnage.description: Reinforce your body with Blackwhip and Blackchain, vastly increasing your stats. Requires Gearshift, Blackchain, high Fajin and you to be crouching to use.
